message:
feat(desktop): UI-012 command registry, keyboard model, focus architecture (#48)

Centralize all app commands behind a typed registry (§23): commands carry
Japanese titles, multi-chord shortcut bindings, and isEnabled/isVisible
predicates evaluated against an immutable CommandSnapshot — so the command
bar, transport bar, menus and keyboard dispatch are one source of truth.

Keyboard model (src/keyboard/):
- KeyChord parsing/matching with shift-implicit symbol keys (Ctrl++ works)
- single window keydown dispatcher: IME-composition safe (isComposing /
  keyCode 229), text-entry suppression, per-control key consumption
  (Space on a button belongs to the button), modal suppression,
  disabled-command swallowing, auto-repeat opt-in, sequence prefixes

Focus architecture (src/focus/):
- F6/Shift+F6 cycle the major regions in spec Tab order via
  data-hs-focus-zone landmarks
- FocusRestorer + useFocusRestoreOnClose wired into HsDialog/HsSheet/
  HsPopover so closing surfaces return focus to the opener only when it
  would otherwise strand on <body>
- :focus-visible uses --hs-focus-width/--hs-focus-offset tokens

Tests: 58 vitest cases — registry conflict detection, dispatcher scope
rules, focus restore, zone cycling.

Refs #24

Generated with [Devin](https://devin.ai)

Co-authored-by: Devin <158243242+devin-ai-integration[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
